page_title: RAY 0-1 BIL | Rayo Vallecano v Athletic Bilbao 25/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

90+4' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Rayo Vallecano win a corner kick.

90+3' Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
90+3' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) will take the corner.

90+2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

88' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Julen Agirrezabala, who pulls off a stunning save!
87' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to gather the ball.
84' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
83' What a chance that is! Pep Chavarria swings the ball into the box, and Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar.
83' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
79' Close! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Unai Lopez as he is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
78' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
78' Total attempts – 11:6. The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) will replace Pathe Ciss.
73' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
73' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
71' Ath Bilbao are ruled offside.
70' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ath Bilbao.
69' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Ath Bilbao will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
68' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Radamel Falcao will be replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).
68' Oscar Trejo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).

67' 0 - 1 Goal! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a short pass from Alex Berenguer in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
66' The attendance is 13090.
65' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
64' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Julen Agirrezabala intercepts the ball.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julen Agirrezabala (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch for Unai Simon.
59' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor is forced to make a change. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Imanol Garcia de Albeniz.
58' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
56' The game is interrupted now, Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' The ball goes out for a corner. Rayo Vallecano can continue in their attacking effort.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano. The referee signals a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.

54' Unai Simon pulls off a great save to deny Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the underside of the crossbar, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Rayo Vallecano get a corner.
53' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
50' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
50' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mikel Jauregizar. He is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) comes off for Dani Vivian.
46' Half-time substitution. Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decided to make a change. Asier Villalibre (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Raul Garcia.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the bottom right corner but is denied by Unai Simon, who pulls off a glorious save!
44' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
42' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
38' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
38' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
35' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
34' Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) jumps into a tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
32' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
30' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
30' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
28' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Simon, who smothers the ball.
28' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
28' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Rayo Vallecano will take a corner kick.
26' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:0.
20' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
16' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
15' An attempted cross from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
13' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
13' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

12' Unai Simon doesn't have to worry about this one. Oscar Trejo plays a pass into the feet of Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
9' CHANCE! Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Jorge de Frutos.
8' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
8' A pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
5' The resulting corner from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) comes to nothing.
4' A pass by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
